name: Cell Retrieval via Neighbor-Finding
aliases: Octree Scalar Field Mapping via Forward Neighbors
definition: A process to retrieve a cell from a neighborhood of voxels by performing neighbor-finding on the octree structure to get forward-neighboring voxels, yielding a cell of 8 voxels used as the intersection primitive.
summary: Cell Retrieval via Neighbor-Finding reconstructs isosurfaces from sparse octrees by dynamically fetching seven forward neighbors to form 8-voxel cells, avoiding explicit storage expansion.
